# MediaX

> Full-service digital marketing agency in Delhi NCR delivering SEO, Google Ads (PPC), social media marketing, branding, video production, and performance marketing.

## About MediaX
MediaX is an integrated digital marketing and creative agency with 8+ years of industry experience and 250+ clients served across India and internationally. Operating from Shahpur Jat, New Delhi, MediaX works as a specialized network of companies under one roof:
- MediaX OOH (Out-of-Home advertising)
- MediaX Click (Creative production studio & podcast sets)
- MediaX Performance+ (Data-driven performance marketing)

## Core Services
- [SEO Services](https://mediax.co.in/digital-marketing-agency-delhi/): Technical SEO, Local SEO for Delhi NCR businesses, on-page optimization, content marketing, and white-hat link building.
- [Google Ads & PPC](https://mediax.co.in/digital-marketing-agency-delhi/): High-intent search campaigns, display ads, shopping ads, and conversion rate optimization (CRO).
- [Social Media Marketing](https://mediax.co.in/digital-marketing-agency-delhi/): Organic brand growth, viral content strategy, paid social ads (Meta, LinkedIn, Instagram), and influencer partnerships.
- [Creative & Branding](https://mediax.co.in/creative-n-branding.html): Brand identity design, corporate decks, logos, and packaging.
- [Film & Photography](https://mediax.co.in/film-n-photography.html): Commercial video shoots, brand films, product photography, and podcast sets.
- [Web & AR Development](https://mediax.co.in/website-n-ar.html): High-speed custom web development, landing pages, and interactive augmented reality.
- [Out-of-Home (OOH)](https://mediax.co.in/outside-of-home.html): Strategic outdoor advertising, prime hoarding placements, and transit media across Delhi NCR.
